correctness.rationale: The exact CodeTables 14-by-23 Wagner generator, retrieved at the assigned Git blob, has rank 14 and independently verified primal minimum distance 5 (all 2^14 primal words). Its dual is ker(G), dimension 9. For every coordinate set X, dim ker(G_X)=|X|-rank(G_X), so d_r=min{|X|:nullity>=r}. A separately written exact XOR-rank implementation exhausted all 2^23=8,388,608 subsets and gave d_1..d_9=(8,12,15,17,18,20,21,22,23), proving both minima and exclusions without sampling; no statement is made about other [23,9] codes.
